command.name: Company Officer
command.direction: Mature British woman; brisk, attentive, measured authority. Emotion without a slow drawl.

kestrel.name: Kestrel Two
kestrel.direction: Young American man. Projects over combat, clipped and breathless under pressure; physical effort persists when relieved.
kestrel.provenance: ElevenLabs premade. Under-fire exchange accepted by user; the calm initial take was rejected.

viper.name: Viper One
viper.direction: American woman, practical and forceful, projecting over firing with controlled strain. Two-line casting sample only.

rook.name: Rook One
rook.direction: Australian man, compact cockpit delivery, alert and conversational; a little levity once the passengers are safely down. Two-line casting sample only.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Command! Kestrel Two, go ahead!

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Take the freight yard. Hold it for the convoy.
lines.synthesisText: [firm, brisk voice] Take the freight yard. Hold it for the convoy.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Freight yard! We'll hold it!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Command, Kestrel Two! We're at the yard. Still taking fire!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Command, Kestrel Two! We're at the yard. Still taking fire!

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Received, Kestrel. Hold your assignment. Report when it's secure.
lines.synthesisText: [firm, brisk voice] Received, Kestrel. Hold your assignment. Report when it's secure.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Kestrel Two, Viper One! We're set. Bring your people across!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained voice] Kestrel Two, Viper One! We're set. Bring your people across!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Viper One! Moving now!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [urgent, strained voice] Got you, Kestrel! Keep coming!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.synthesisText: [breathless, relieved voice] We're through! Much appreciated!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Command, Rook One. Reinforcements are down. Lifting clear.
lines.synthesisText: [focused, brisk voice] Command, Rook One. Reinforcements are down. Lifting clear.

lines.speaker: command
lines.text: Received, Rook. Return to the ship.
lines.synthesisText: [matter-of-fact, brisk voice] Received, Rook. Return to the ship.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: On my way. Try to leave me a parking space.
lines.synthesisText: [wry, conversational voice] On my way. Try to leave me a parking space.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Command, Kestrel Two. Freight yard secure. We're holding.
lines.synthesisText: [breathless, relieved voice] Command, Kestrel Two. Freight yard secure. We're holding.

lines.speaker: command
lines.synthesisText: [warm, firm voice] Good work, Kestrel. Hold there.

exchanges.title: Assignment under fire
exchanges.trigger: A new, accepted own-squad SECURE_COMPOUND directive for a known freight yard; convoy support is actually part of the mission.
exchanges.cancel: Squad lost, assignment replaced/released, or named destination no longer matches.

exchanges.title: At the yard, still fighting
exchanges.trigger: Assigned squad observed inside the named objective and currently engaged; arrival is not capture.
exchanges.cancel: Assignment changed, squad lost, or the yard is secured before this starts.

exchanges.title: One squad covers another
exchanges.trigger: A real support relationship, ready covering squad and actual crossing by the named supported squad; current radio policy does not publish this evidence.
exchanges.cancel: Cover or crossing canceled, either squad lost, or named roles changed. Final report requires an observed completed crossing.

exchanges.title: Transport checks in
exchanges.trigger: Committed own transport has physically unloaded its assigned passengers and is departing; completion of a request alone is insufficient.
exchanges.cancel: Aircraft lost, delivery aborted/partial, or no valid return route. Banter is optional and suppressed under pressure.

exchanges.title: Capture and hold
exchanges.trigger: A confirmed own-force capture of the named yard with this living squad still assigned to hold it.
exchanges.cancel: Yard lost, assignment changed, or squad lost.

mix.note: Compressed audition reel; pilot's initial report overlaps the contested squad update on a separate monitored net. Routine in-game traffic should be much sparser.
